name: Monitoring rules for the v86 / bf26 paper runs (registered 2026-10-23, before any verdict; complement the gates in config/paper_v86.json and config/paper_bf26.json)

weekly (each share).reconcile: hourly correlation paper vs recomputation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find the cause before anything else (data gap, code change, late hours)
weekly (each share).late hours: share of hours computed late <= 5% over the run; crashes / restarts are logged in research/PAPER_LOG.md

alerts (look closer, no action yet).drawdown: paper drawdown worse than -8% at risk 2.0
alerts (look closer, no action yet).sleeve: a sleeve with a cumulative unit-size paper loss worse than -3 times its backtest daily sd x sqrt(days)
alerts (look closer, no action yet).daily stops: more than 3 daily-stop days in any 14-day window
alerts (look closer, no action yet).sleeve decay (Gen328): a sleeve's trailing 12-month Sharpe below 0 AND below its own historical 10th percentile -> review that sleeve (none triggered on 2026-09-30; weakest: C*, alt kimchi)

stop (as the gate): drawdown worse than -12%, or after >= 56 days z < -2; then: no purchase, find the cause
go: after >= 56 days and >= 2 Weiss expiries: z > -1, reconcile clean, late hours <= 5%, AND Gen321 (survivorship) passed
never: no change to the running paper code or parameters because of paper results; changes only as new versions after the review
